oromo: waggoota digdama dura, lammii Mongoliyaa kan taate Altantuya Shaariibuu, poolisoota addaa Maleeziyaan ajjeefamtee qaamni ishee dhuka'insa maashiniin barbadaa'eera. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, ajjeechaan kun dhimma shimmiggaa (submarine) waliin walqabatuu fi namoota sadarkaa olaanaa irra jiran, kanneen akka ministira mummee durii Naajiib Raazaak, waliin walqabachuu danda'a jedhamee shakkama. Yakkitoonni yoo adabamanis, sababa dhugaa ajjeechaa kanaa fi gahee angawootaa irratti shakkiiwwan gurguddoon ammas jiru.

title: Rubio’s Uzbekistan trip underlines Central Asia’s hunt for diverse partners
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting Uzbekistan for a C5+1 summit, marking a shift in American diplomacy toward a pragmatic, transactional relationship with Central Asian nations. The United States is moving away from its previous focus on human rights and democratic lecturing to better compete with the influence of Russia and China. This new approach aims to strengthen regional ties by prioritizing economic and strategic cooperation over political conditions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በኡዝቤኪስታን ጉብኝት በማድረግ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት አሜሪካ ከማዕከላዊ እስያ ሀገራት ጋር ያላትን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ከሰብአዊ መብት እና ከዴሞክራሲ ትችት ወደ ተግባራዊ እና የኢኮኖሚ ትብብር ላይ ያተኮረ አካሄድ ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው። አሜሪካ በክልሉ የሩሲያ እና የቻይና ተፅእኖ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ፣ ከፖለቲካዊ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ይልቅ ለስልታዊ አጋርነት ቅድሚያ እየሰጠች ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarko Rubiyoon biyya Uuzbekistaan daawwachaa jiru. Daawwannaan kun Ameerikaan hariiroo biyyoota Eshiyaa Giddugaleessaa wajjin qabdu caalaatti xiyyeeffannoo dinagdee fi hariiroo qabatamaa irratti akka taasisitu agarsiisa. Ameerikaan duraan mirga namoomaa fi dimokiraasii irratti xiyyeeffachaa turte, amma garuu dhiibbaa Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaan naannichatti uumaa jiran dorgomuuf jecha, dhimma siyaasaa irra walta'iinsa istiraategii fi dinagdee dursaa jirti.

title: Oregon school shooter was former special-needs student, police say
english: Authorities have identified the 16-year-old shooter responsible for a deadly attack at an Oregon elementary school as a former student who previously received special education services. The tragic incident resulted in the deaths of three children and one teacher. Officials are currently investigating the background of the perpetrator as the community deals with the aftermath of the violence.
amharic: የኦሪገን ግዛት ባለስልጣናት በአንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ጥቃት የፈጸመው የ16 ዓመቱ ወጣት ቀደም ሲል በዚያው ትምህርት ቤት ልዩ ድጋፍ የሚያስፈልጋቸው ተማሪዎች ፕሮግራም ውስጥ የነበረ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ሶስት ህጻናትን እና አንድ አስተማሪን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። ጉዳዩ በፖሊስ እየተጣራ ሲሆን፣ ማህበረሰቡም በጥቃቱ መደናገጡን ሰምተናል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa biyya Ooregon akka ibsanitti, dargaggeessi umriin isaa waggaa 16 ta'eefi mana barnoota sadarkaa tokkooffaa keessatti miidhaa geessise kun, duraan barataa mana barnootichaa kan tureefi deeggarsa addaa argachaa ture dha. Haleellaa raawwatame kanaan ijoolleen sadiifi barsiisaan tokko lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Poolisiin dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Wildfire prompts thousands of evacuation orders in Orange County
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in Southern California's Orange County has forced thousands of residents to leave their homes. Powerful Santa Ana winds are complicating firefighting efforts and causing the flames to move quickly. So far, at least six residential properties have been destroyed by the fire.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ካሊፎርኒያ ኦሬንጅ ካውንቲ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ የሚገኝ የዱር እሳት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አስገድዷል። አካባቢው ላይ እየነፈሰ ያለው ኃይለኛ ነፋስ የእሳት አደጋ መቆጣጠር ስራውን አስቸጋሪ በማድረጉ እሳቱ በፍጥነት እንዲሰራጭ አድርጓል። እስካሁን በደረሰው ጉዳት ቢያንስ ስድስት የመኖሪያ ቤቶች በእሳት መውደማቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Orange County kan Kaaliforniyaa kibbatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'ataa jiruun jiraattonni kumaan lakkaa'aman manneen isaanii gadhiisanii akka bahan dirqamsiiseera. Bubbeen cimaan naannichatti qilleensa jiru humna ibiddaa dabaluun dhaamsuu isaa rakkisaa godheera. Hangas ammaatti, manneen jireenyaa yoo xiqqaate ja'a ibidda kanaan barbadaa'aniiru.

title: Why Israel's claims cannot be accepted at face value
english: A recent BBC investigation found that the Israeli military frequently fails to provide follow-up information on hundreds of internal investigations regarding civilian harm. Critics who question these narratives or analyze the potential political motives behind specific events often face intense backlash from politicians and media outlets. This highlights a growing concern that skepticism toward official claims is being wrongly conflated with prejudice rather than viewed as a standard part of responsible journalism.
amharic: የቢቢሲ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል በተባሉ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ጉዳዮች ላይ የሚያደርገውን ምርመራ ውጤት ይፋ የማድረግ ግዴታውን እንደማይወጣ አሳይቷል። እነዚህን መግለጫዎች የሚጠይቁ ወይም ከክስተቶች በስተጀርባ ያሉ የፖለቲካ ዓላማዎችን የሚተነትኑ ሰዎች ብዙ ጊዜ በፖለቲከኞች እና በመገናኛ ብዙኃን ከፍተኛ ትችት ይደርስባቸዋል። ይህም ኦፊሴላዊ መረጃዎችን መጠራጠር እንደ መጥፎ አመለካከት መቆጠሩ፣ እንደ ሙያዊ ጋዜጠኝነት መለኪያ አለመታየቱ ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC dhihoo kana gaggeesse akka ibsetti, waraanni Israa'el miidhaa sivilii irratti ga'e jedhamee qorannoon irratti baname lakkoofsaan baay'ee ta'an irratti hordoffii gahaa fi ragaa ifa ta'e akka hin kennine agarsiiseera. Namoonni ibsa mootummaa kana shakkanii fi sababa siyaasaa gara duuba isaa jiru kan qoratan, siyaas-aasaa fi miidiyaalee garaagaraa irraa kaniin mormamanii fi qeeqaman ta'uun isaanii eerameera. Kunis, odeeffannoo mootummaan kennu shakkisiisuun akka jibbaatti ilaalamuu malee, akka hojii gaazexeessummaa itti gaafatamummaa qabuutti hin ilaalamu jechuun rakkoo guddaa ta'uu isaa ibsa.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following reports of tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and off the coast of Saudi Arabia, prompting a US blockade of Iranian shipping. Meanwhile, violence has increased in Yemen and the West Bank, where Israeli settlers have targeted Palestinian farmers and humanitarian concerns are rising. Furthermore, international leaders and organizations are raising alarms over the economic impact of regional instability and the mistreatment of minors in detention facilities.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ እና በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢ በተከሰቱ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች ጥቃት ሳቢያ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል፤ ይህም አሜሪካ በአንጻሩ በአይራን መርከቦች ላይ ማዕቀብ እንድትጥል አስገድዷል። በሌላ በኩል በየመን እና በምዕራብ ባንክ ግጭቶች ተባብሰው የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስታይናውያን ገበሬዎች ላይ ጥቃት እየሰነዘሩ መሆኑ በሰብዓዊ መብት ረገጣ ዙሪያ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎችም በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት በአለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ እና በእስር ቤት በሚገኙ ህጻናት ላይ እያደረሰ ስላለው ተጽዕኖ ከፍተኛ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Hanga'inni biyyoota gidduu galaa bahaa dabaleera; kunis weerara markaba boba'aa kan Hormuz fi qarqara galaana Sa'udii keessatti raawwatamee fi tarkaanfii galaana Iran irratti Ameerikaan fudhatteen walqabata. Gama biraatiin, Yemen fi naannoo Qarqara Lixaatti walitti bu'iinsi hammaateera; keessattuu namoonni biyyattii keessaa buqqa'anii lafa isaanii irratti qonnaan bultoota Palastin irratti haleellaan raawwatamaa jiraachuu gabaasameera. Dabalataanis, hogganoonni fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa miidhaa diinagdee fi mirga ijoollee mana hidhaa keessa jiran ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: UKMTO says unknown projectile hit tanker off Saudi Arabia's coast
english: A tanker ship was hit by an unidentified projectile while sailing off the coast of Saudi Arabia near Al Jubail. Fortunately, all crew members were safely evacuated from the vessel. Authorities confirmed that there have been no signs of environmental damage resulting from the attack.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ውስጥ በአል ጁባይል አቅራቢያ የሚጓዝ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመቷል። በመርከቡ ላይ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች በሙሉ ምንም ጉዳት ሳይደርስባቸው በሰላም ለቀው ወጥተዋል። ከጥቃቱ በኋላ ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመከሰቱም ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Markabni boba'aa fe'ee deemu tokko qarqara galaana Sa'udii Arabaa, naannoo Al-Jubailitti wanta hin beekamne tokkoon rukutameera. Haa ta'u malee, hojjettoonni markabichaa hundi miidhaa tokko malee nagaan lubbuun oolaniiru. Ajjeechaa kanaanis miidhaan naannoo irratti ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Israeli forces arrest two Palestinians, settlers open fire at farmers in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have launched several violent attacks against Palestinian farmers and residential areas across the occupied West Bank, resulting in multiple injuries. During the same period, Israeli security forces conducted dawn raids in Nablus and a nearby village, leading to the arrest of two Palestinian men. These incidents reflect an ongoing escalation of tensions and violence in the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ገበሬዎችና መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው በርካቶች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ የእስራኤል የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በናቡለስ እና በአቅራቢያው በሚገኝ መንደር ባደረጉት ወረራ ሁለት ፓለስቲናውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ግጭትና ውጥረት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Godina waraanaan qabamee jiru West Bank keessatti, qubattoonni Israa'el qonnaan bultoota Palastaayinii fi manneen jireenyaa irratti haleellaa raawwataniin namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, loltoonni Israa'el magaalaa Naablus fi baadiyaa ishee bira jiru keessatti sakatta'iinsa taasisaniin dhiirota Palastaayinii lama qabanii hidhaniiru. Gochi kun naannichatti walitti bu'iinsii fi sodaannaan dabalaa dhufuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure 'worrying' for Pakistan's outlook, minister says
english: Pakistan's finance minister, Muhammad Aurangzeb, stated that while the country has successfully managed current energy needs despite rising costs, recent attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure are causing significant economic concern. Although Pakistan has secured sufficient fuel supplies for the coming weeks, the government remains cautious about future price hikes and potential shortages. The minister warned that ongoing damage to regional energy facilities could hinder global economic recovery and complicate Pakistan's ability to maintain energy stability.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ሙሐመድ አውራንገዜብ እንደተናገሩት አገሪቱ የወቅቱን የኢነርጂ ፍላጎት በበቂ ሁኔታ መሸፈን ብትችልም፣ በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት የኢነርጂ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ እየደረሱ ያሉት ጥቃቶች ለኢኮኖሚዋ ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። ፓኪስታን እስከ ህዳር ወር ድረስ በቂ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እንዳላት የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ በክልሉ የሚፈጠሩ ጥቃቶች የዓለምን የኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት በማደናቀፍ የሀገሪቱን የረጅም ጊዜ እቅድ ሊጎዱ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Paakistaan Muhammad Aurangzeb akka jedhanitti, biyyattiin gatii gurguddaa ta'e danda'uudhaan fedhii anniisaa ishee ammaaf guuttachuu dandeessus, weerarri bu'uuraalee misoomaa anniisaa biyyoota Guldii irratti raawwatamu kun diinagdee isaanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. Paakistaan hanga ji'a Sadaasaatti boba'aa gahaa qabaachuu ishee kan ibsan ministirichi, miidhaan naannicha keessatti dhaqqabu kun tasgabbii diinagdee addunyaa boquudhaan karoora dheeraa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
english: Brazil has reported a record-breaking 41.8% drop in Amazon deforestation ahead of the upcoming presidential election. This decline follows President Lula da Silva's efforts to strengthen environmental protections and reverse the policies of his predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro. As the nation prepares for a competitive vote, officials view this success as a major milestone toward the goal of eliminating illegal deforestation by 2030.
amharic: ብራዚል በቅርቡ በሚካሄደው ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ዋዜማ በአማዞን የደን መጨፍጨፍ መጠን የ41.8 በመቶ ከፍተኛ ቅናሽ አሳይታለች። ይህ ለውጥ የተገኘው ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ የቀድሞውን አስተዳደር ፖሊሲዎች በመቀየር የአካባቢ ጥበቃ እርምጃዎችን በማጠናከራቸው ነው። መንግስት እ.ኤ.አ በ2030 ህገ-ወጥ የደን መጨፍጨፍን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማስቆም የያዘውን ግብ ለማሳካት ይህንን ውጤት ትልቅ ስኬት አድርጎ ይቆጥረዋል።
oromo: Braziil filannoo pirezidaantummaa dhufuuf jedhu dura, manca’iinsa bosona Amaazoinii keessatti hir’ina seenaa qabeessa kan ta’e dhibbeentaa 41.8 galmeessiteetti. Hir’inni kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaant Luulaa da Silvaa tarkaanfii eegumsa naannoo jabeessanii fi imaammata bulchiinsa duraanii jijjiiranii booda. Mootummaan hanga bara 2030tti manca’iinsa bosonaa seeraan alaa guutummaatti dhaabuuf karoorfate keessatti, milkaa’inni kun tarkaanfii guddaa akka ta’e ibseera.

title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as new US law takes effect
english: President Donald Trump has issued an executive order to block various sanctions against Russia, despite having signed the legislation into law just last month. He argues that pausing these measures, which were intended to punish Russia for the war in Ukraine, is necessary for U.S. national interests. This decision has sparked significant backlash from lawmakers who believe the sanctions are crucial for holding Moscow accountable and supporting Ukraine.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ ለከፈተችው ጦርነት ቅጣት እንዲሆኑ በኮንግረስ የጸደቁትን ማዕቀቦች ተግባራዊ እንዳይሆኑ በስልጣናቸው አግደዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እርምጃውን የወሰዱት የአሜሪካን ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ በሚል ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ውሳኔው በኮንግረስ አባላት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች የሩሲያን ኢኮኖሚ እና ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናትን ለመጉዳት የታለሙ ነበሩ።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waraana Yukreen irratti gaggeeffameef jecha Raashiyaa irratti akka fudhatamu seeraan tumamee ture ugguruuf aangoo isaanii fayyadamaniiru. Pireezidaantichi tarkaanfiin kun faayidaa biyyaa Ameerikaa eeguuf barbaachisaa dha jedhanii kan amananii fi murtichi miseensota Koongireesii biratti mormii cimaa kan kaase dha. Seerichi dinagdee Raashiyaa fi aangomtoota biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuuf kan qophaa'e ture.

title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
english: A Mexican court has sentenced three men to over 158 years in prison each for the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend. The victims were killed during a failed robbery of their vehicle while on a surfing trip in Baja California. This tragic event caused widespread international outcry and highlighted security concerns in a region popular with tourists.
amharic: የሜክिको ፍርድ ቤት በ2024 ሁለት አውስትራሊያዊ ወንድማማቾችን እና አንድ አሜሪካዊ ጓደኛቸውን በመግደል ወንጀል የተከሰሱ ሶስት ግለሰቦችን እያንዳንዳቸው በ158 ዓመት ከዘጠኝ ወር እስራት ቀጣ። ግለሰቦቹ የተገደሉት በባጃ ካሊፎርኒያ የሰርፊንግ ጉዞ ላይ እያሉ ተሽከርካሪያቸውን ለመዝረፍ በተደረገ ሙከራ ወቅት ነው። ይህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤ የፈጠረ ሲሆን በቱሪስት መዳረሻ አካባቢዎች ያለውን የጸጥታ ስጋት አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Mana murtii Meksiko tokko namoota sadii waggaa 158 fi ji'a sagaliin akka hidhaman murteesse; kunis obboleewwan Awustiraaliyaa lama fi hiriyyaa isaanii Ameerikaa tokko ajjeesuu isaaniitiin kan dhufedha. Namoonni kunneen bara 2024 bakka bishaan keessatti bultii (surfing) godhanitti konkolaataa isaanii saamuuf yaalame irratti ajjeefaman. Yakki suukkanneessaan kun addunyaa guutuu irratti rifaatuu kan uume yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan tuuristoonni itti baay'atan keessatti nageenyi hagam akka yaaddessu ifa godheera.

title: Russian attacks in Ukraine kill at least 8, cut power to 1 million
english: Russian airstrikes across nine Ukrainian regions have resulted in at least eight deaths and dozens of injuries while causing significant damage to civilian infrastructure. The attacks targeted shopping centers and the nation's energy grid, leaving over a million people temporarily without electricity. Repair teams are working to restore power, but the UN warns that civilian casualties in the conflict have risen sharply in recent months.
amharic: በዘጠኝ የዩክሬን ክልሎች በተካሄደው የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የገበያ ማዕከላትን እና የኃይል ማመንጫ መሠረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ በማድረግ ከሁለት ሚሊዮን በላይ ለሚሆኑ ሰዎች የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት መቋረጡን አስከትሏል። የጥገና ቡድኖች የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦትን ለመመለስ እየሠሩ ቢሆንም፣ የተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅት በቅርብ ወራት ውስጥ በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ የሚደርሰው የጉዳት መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa naannolee Yukreen saglan keessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa gaggeesseen lubbuun namoota saddeetii darbee namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun buufataalee gabaa fi kutaalee tajaajila humna elektirikii irratti xiyyeeffachuun, namoota miiliyoona tokko ol ta'aniif elektirikiin akka addaan citu godheera. Gareen suphaa tajaajila elektirikii deebisuuf hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, gamtaan mootummoota gamtoomanii baatiiwwan darban keessa miidhaan siivilii irra ga'u dabaluu isaa akeekkachiiseera.

title: Three Mexicans jailed for 158 years each for killing Australian, US surfers
english: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to over 158 years in prison each for the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend. The victims were killed while on a surfing trip in Baja California, and their bodies were later discovered in a deep well with gunshot wounds. This case drew significant international attention and raised concerns regarding the safety of tourists visiting the region.
amharic: የሜክሲኮ ዳኛ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ሁለት አውስትራሊያውያን ወንድማማቾችን እና አሜሪካዊ ጓደኛቸውን የገደሉ ሶስት ወንጀለኞችን እያንዳንዳቸው ከ158 ዓመት በላይ በሚደርስ እስራት እንዲቀጡ ወሰኑ። ተጎጂዎቹ በባጃ ካሊፎርኒያ በሰርፊንግ ጉዞ ላይ እያሉ ነበር የተገደሉት፤ አስከሬናቸውም በጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ በጥይት ተመተው ተገኝቷል። ይህ ክስተት ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን የሳበ ሲሆን ወደ አካባቢው በሚሄዱ ቱሪስቶች ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbaan murtii biyya Meksikoo namoota sadii kan bara 2024 obboloota Awustiraaliyaa lamaafi hiriyyaa isaanii Ameerikaa tokko ajjeesaniif, hundi isaanii waggaa 158 ol akka hidhaman murteesse. Miidhamtoonni kunneen yeroo isaan bakka Baaja Kaalifoorniyaatti surfiingii gochaa turanitti ajjeefaman; reeffi isaaniis boolla gad fagoo keessatti rasaasaan rukutamee argame. Dhimmi kun xiyyeeffannaa addunyaa kan harkise yoo ta'u, nageenya turistonni gara naannichaa dhufanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: The Israeli politicians seeking to replace Netanyahu
english: Five prominent Israeli opposition leaders have formed a pact to challenge Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the upcoming October 27 election. While they aim to replace his government, most of these candidates share right-wing views and do not fundamentally differ from Netanyahu regarding the conflicts in Gaza and Lebanon. With the exception of one party leader, none of the candidates support Palestinian statehood or criticize the ongoing military campaigns.
amharic: አምስት ታዋቂ የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚ መሪዎች በጥቅምት 27 በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁንን ለመገዳደር ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። እነዚህ እጩዎች የመንግስት ለውጥ ለማምጣት ቢፈልጉም፣ በአብዛኛው ከኔታንያሁን ጋር ተመሳሳይ የቀኝ ዘመም አስተሳሰብ ያላቸው በመሆኑ በጋዛ እና በሊባኖስ ግጭቶች ላይ ያላቸው አቋም ትልቅ ለውጥ አያሳይም። ከአንድ መሪ በስተቀር አንዳቸውም የፍልስጤምን ነጻ ሀገርነት የማይደግፉ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች ላይም ወሳኝ ትችት የላቸውም።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mormituu Israa'el shan ta'an, filannoo Onkololeessa 27 dhufu irratti muummicha ministeeraa Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuun buusuuf walii galtee uumaniiru. Mootummaa isaanii jijjiiruuf kan ka'an ta'us, dhimmoota Gazaafi Liibaanoos irratti ilaalchi isaanii kan Netaaniyaahuun irraa kan gargar ba'u miti. Hoggantoota kana keessaa tokko malee, kaan hundi isaanii biyyattii Paalastayinii hundeessuu kan hin deeggarreefi duula waraanaa ammaa irratti mormii guddaa kan hin qabne dha.

title: Trump waives Russia sanctions as rift with Zelenskyy widens
english: US President Donald Trump has officially removed certain sanctions against Russia, claiming the move is intended to help lower global energy costs. This decision has sparked significant backlash from Ukrainian officials and leaders across the European Union. Furthermore, this policy change highlights a growing tension and diplomatic distance between the Trump administration and Ukraine's President Zelenskyy.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ በሚል በሩሲያ ላይ ተጥለው የነበሩ አንዳንድ ማዕቀቦችን አንስተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዩክሬን እና በአውሮፓ ህብረት አገራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ድርጊቱ በትራምፕ እና በዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ መካከል ያለው የፖለቲካ ልዩነት እያደገ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, gatii anniisaa gadi buusuuf jechuun tajaajila adda addaa irratti Rushiyaa irra kaa'amee ture kaasuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun biyyoota Yukreeniifi gamtaa Awurooppaa irraa mormii cimaa kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, hariiroon pirezidaantichaafi pirezidaantii Yukreen Zeeleniskii gidduu jiru caalaatti hammuu akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Trump puts on hold new Russia sanctions he signed into law
english: President Trump has delayed the implementation of new, bipartisan sanctions against Russia that were intended to target its financial and energy sectors. Despite the law passing with strong support from Congress, the president used an executive order to pause the measures, citing national security interests. This decision follows a controversial agreement by the U.S. to purchase diesel from Russia and has drawn significant criticism from lawmakers concerned about its impact on the war in Ukraine.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሩሲያ ላይ ተጥለው የነበሩትን አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦች ተግባራዊ እንዳይሆኑ አግደዋል። በኮንግረስ ከፍተኛ ድጋፍ የተላለፈው ይህ ህግ የሩሲያን የገንዘብ እና የነዳጅ ዘርፍ ኢላማ ያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ ፕሬዝዳንቱ ብሄራዊ ጥቅምን መሠረት በማድረግ ማዕቀቡ እንዲዘገይ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ከሩሲያ ናፍጣ ለመግዛት መስማማቷን ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ላይ የሚያሳድረውን ተጽእኖ በመፍራት በበርካታ የህግ አውጭዎች ትችት ቀርቦበታል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Traamp tarkaanfii sanada seeraa biyya Rashiyaa irratti erga mirkaneessan booda, adabbiiwwan haaraa irra kaa'uuf turan yeroof dhaabaniiru. Seerichi kan tumame gargaarsa guddaa Kongirasii irraa argatee ta'us, pirezidaantichi faayidaa biyyaa sababa godhachuun ajaja baasuudhaan adabbii kana darbaniru. Murtiin kun walii galtee Ameerikaan Rashiyaa irraa boba'aa (diesel) bituuf gootee wajjin kan walqabatu yoo ta'u, kunis waraana Yuukireyn irratti dhiibbaa waan geessisuuf miseensonni Kongirasii hedduun mormii guddaa dhageessisaniiru.

title: Woman killed, five civilians injured in Houthi shelling and sniper fire
english: A woman was killed and five others, including a child, were wounded following Houthi attacks in the Taiz province of Yemen. The assault involved both artillery shelling and sniper fire aimed at residential villages in the Sabir al-Mawadim district. Local human rights officials confirmed the incident as an attack on civilian homes.
amharic: በየመን ታይዝ ግዛት ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የከባድ መሳሪያ እና የጥይት ተኩስ ጥቃት አንድ ሴት ህይወቷ ሲያልፍ፣ አንዲት ህጻንን ጨምሮ አምስት ንጹሃን ዜጎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በሳቢር አል-መዋዲም ወረዳ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ነው። የአካባቢው የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋማት ጉዳቱ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ እንደሆነ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Godina Ta'iz kan Yaman keessatti haleellaa hidhattoota Huutii raawwataniin dubartiin tokko yoo duutu, namoonni shan biroon immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaa irra ga'e keessatti daa'imni tokko kan argamu yoo ta'u, haleellaan kunis kan raawwatame bulchiinsa Sabir al-Mawadim keessatti bakka jireenya namootaa irratti dha. Waajjirri mirga namoomaa naannichaa akka mirkaneessetti, haleellaan kun gara maneen jireenyaa fi gandoota nagaatti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Canada condemns Houthi strikes on Maashiq Palace in Aden
english: Canada has officially denounced a recent Houthi attack on the Maashiq Palace located in Aden, Yemen, which resulted in five deaths and several injuries. Through its embassy, the Canadian government expressed sympathy for the affected families and hopes for the recovery of the wounded. Furthermore, Canadian officials have urged all involved parties to stop the violence immediately to prevent further conflict.
amharic: ካናዳ በየመን አደን ከተማ በሚገኘው ማሺቅ ቤተመንግስት ላይ ሁቲዎች የፈጸሙትን ጥቃት በይፋ አውግዛለች። የሁቲዎች ጥቃት የአምስት ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎችም ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የካናዳ መንግስት ለተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች መጽናናትን የተመኘ ሲሆን፣ ግጭቱ በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆምም ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Kanaadaan haleellaa gareen Huutii buufata mootummaa Maashiq kan magaalaa Aden, Yemen keessatti raawwate balaaleffatteetti. Haleellaa kanaan lubbuun namoota shan darbee kanneen biroo irrattis miidhaan ga'eera. Mootummaan Kanaadaa maatii miidhaan irra ga'eef gadda itti dhaga'ame ibsuun, waraanni fi walitti bu'iinsi biyyattii keessatti yeroodhaan akka dhaabbatu gaafateera.

title: Pezeshkian calls environmental destruction caused by regional wars 'ecocide'
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has labeled the environmental damage caused by regional wars, particularly in Gaza, as 'ecocide.' During a biodiversity summit in Armenia, he urged global leaders to create stronger protections for nature, noting that military conflicts destroy forests, water, and soil for generations. He emphasized that ecological destruction crosses borders and requires international condemnation and urgent action.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ማስኡድ ፔዘሽኪያን በክልሉ በሚደረጉ ጦርነቶች በተለይም በጋዛ የሚደርሰውን የአካባቢ ጥፋት 'ኢኮሳይድ' ወይም ስነ-ምህዳርን መግደል ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። በአርሜኒያ በተካሄደው የብዝሃ ህይወት ጉባኤ ላይ የተገኙት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ጦርነት ተፈጥሮን፣ ደኖችን እና የውሃ ሃብቶችን ለረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚጎዳ በመግለጽ አለማቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን ድርጊት እንዲያወግዝ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የአካባቢ ብክለት ድንበር እንደማያውቅ የገለጹት ፔዘሽኪያን፣ ጦርነት በሰው ልጅ ላይ ከሚያደርሰው ጉዳት ባሻገር በተፈጥሮ ስነ-ምህዳር ላይ የሚያደርሰው ተጽዕኖ ዘላቂ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan waraana naannichatti, keessattuu Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun miidhaan naannoo irra gahu 'ekosaaydii' ykn balleessa naannoo jedhanii waamaniiru. Waltajjii biyyoolessotaa Armeniyaatti gaggeeffame irratti, waraanichi bosona, bishaan, fi biyyeetti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu fi miidhaan kun dhaloota dhufuuf akka daddarbu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantiin kun, miidhaan naannoo daangaa biyyaa qaxxaamuree waan darbuuf, hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii cimaa fudhatee kunuunsa naannoo waraana keessatti mirkaneessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: US lawmakers demand action after attack on Washington Post journalist
english: Several US lawmakers are calling on the Trump administration to hold Israeli settlers accountable following a violent attack on Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine in the West Bank. Legislators condemned the assault and criticized the lack of consequences for settler violence against both Americans and Palestinians. Some officials are now demanding that the US stop providing aid that supports these activities.
amharic: በርካታ የአሜሪካ ህግ አውጪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በዋሽንግተን ፖስት ፎቶግራፍ አንሺ ሃይዲ ሌቪን ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ላይ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ነው። ህግ አውጪዎቹ ጥቃቱን ያወገዙ ሲሆን በአሜሪካውያን እና በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ለሚፈጸመው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ተጠያቂነት አለመኖሩን ነቅፈዋል። አንዳንድ ባለስልጣናት አሜሪካ ለእነዚህ እንቅስቃሴዎች ድጋፍ የሚሰጠውን እርዳታ እንድታቆም እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Miseensonni seera baastuu Ameerikaa hedduun, fotograafii Washington Post kan taate Heidi Levine irratti daandii West Bank keessatti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda, bulchiinsi Trump namoota haleellaa sana raawwatan irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafachaa jiru. Bakka buutonni kun haleellaa sana kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, namootni qe'ee qabatan kun Ameerikaanotaa fi Falasxiinota irratti haleellaa raawwatanis adabbii malee hafuun isaanii akka isaan aarse ibsaniiru. Qaamni tokko tokko immoo Ameerikaan gargaarsa Israa'eliif kennitu kan haleellaa akkanaa kana deeggaru dhaabuu akka qabdu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Most minors subjected to solitary confinement in Israeli prisons Palestinians, report says
english: A recent report indicates that over half of the minors held in Israeli prisons in 2025 were subjected to solitary confinement, with the vast majority being Palestinian children. Data shows that hundreds of these young detainees were placed in isolation for days or even weeks, often before they had even been convicted of a crime. Human rights advocates are raising serious concerns about the mental and physical impact of this frequent practice on children.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 በእስራኤል እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ ከሚገኙ ታዳጊዎች ውስጥ ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት ብቻቸውን እንዲታሰሩ መደረጉን አንድ ሪፖርት ያሳያል። አብዛኞቹ ታዳጊዎች ፍልስጤማውያን ሲሆኑ፣ ብዙዎቹም ገና የፍርድ ሂደት ሳይጠናቀቅ ወይም ክስ ሳይመሰረትባቸው ለቀናት ወይም ለሳምንታት በብቸኝነት ታስረዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ድርጊት በህጻናት ላይ ሊያደርስ የሚችለውን ከፍተኛ የአእምሮ እና የአካል ጉዳት በመጥቀስ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gabaasni dhiheenya kana bahe akka agarsiisutti, bara 2025 mana hidhaa Israa'el keessatti ijoollee hidhamanii turan keessaa walakkaa ol ta'an kophatti akka hidhaman taasifamaniiru. Ijoolleen kun hedduun isaanii Falasxiinota yoo ta'an, baay'een isaanii immoo osoo yakki irratti hin mirkanaa'in ykn abbaan murtiin osoo hin murtaa'in guyyoota ykn torbanootaaf kophaatti hidhamanii turaniiru. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa gochi kun miidhaa sammuu fi qaamaa ijoollee irratti geessisuuf malu irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Diverse Ethiopian opposition groups, including the TPLF, Fano, and OLA, are forming an informal alliance known as Tsmido with the primary shared goal of removing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed. While these groups are united against a common adversary, they lack a unified ideological vision and remain deeply divided on the country’s future political structure. This strategy carries significant risks, as the potential collapse of federal authority could lead to state fragmentation or renewed conflict rather than a stable transition.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የተለያዩ የተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች፣ የትግራይ ህዝብ ነጻነት ግንባር፣ ፋኖን እና የኦሮሞ ነጻነት ሰራዊትን ጨምሮ፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አብይ አህመድን ለማስወገድ 'ጽሚዶ' በተሰኘ ስም አንድ ላይ ለመስራት እየሞከሩ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በአንድ የጋራ ጠላት ላይ ቢስማሙም፣ ስለ ሀገሪቱ የወደፊት የፖለቲካ መዋቅር እና አቅጣጫ ግን ከፍተኛ የሃሳብ ልዩነት አላቸው። ይህ የጋራ ጥምረት የፌዴራል መንግስትን ለማዳከም የሚያደርጉት ሙከራ ለሀገር መፈራረስ ወይም ለተጨማሪ ግጭት ሊዳርግ የሚችል አደገኛ አካሄድ እንደሆነ ይተነተናል።
oromo: gareewwan mormituu Itoophiyaa garaa garaa, kan akka TPLF, Fano fi WBO, kaayyoo tokko irratti xiyyeeffachuun, inniis Ministira Muummee Abiy Ahimad aangoo irraa kaasuuf 'Tsmido' jedhamuun walitti dhufuuf yaalaa jiru. Gareewwan kun diina tokko irratti waliigaluus, waa'ee gara fuulduraa biyyattii fi bocca siyaasaa irratti yaada tokko hin qaban. Yaaliin gareewwan kun mootummaa federaalaa laaffisuuf godhan kun, biyyattii gara diigamuutti ykn walitti bu'iinsa haaraatti geessuu danda'a waan ta'eef, tarkaanfii baay'ee yaaddessaa dha.

title: #ትሰማ Unmasks a Power Struggle Over Culture in Ethiopia
english: The Ethiopian #ትሰማ (Let Her Be Heard) campaign is calling for government action against violence targeting women and girls, arguing that systemic failures in justice and accountability must be addressed. While the movement highlights specific cases of abuse to demand institutional reform, it has also sparked a debate over whether these efforts reflect Western influence or a necessary cultural shift. Ultimately, the campaign is challenging society to reconsider how it handles gender-based violence and who holds the power to shape these important national conversations.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ #ትሰማ ዘመቻ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል መንግስት ተገቢውን እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቀ ነው። እንቅስቃሴው የፍትህ ስርዓቱ በጉዳዮቹ ላይ የላላ ምላሽ እየሰጠ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ አጠቃላይ ችግሩን ለመቅረፍ ተቋማዊ ለውጥ እንደሚያስፈልግ ይከራከራል። ይሁን እንጂ ዘመቻው በህብረተሰቡ ዘንድ የተቀላቀለ ምላሽ ያገኘ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንዶች ይህ የባህል ለውጥ የውጭ ተጽዕኖ መሆኑን በመጠራጠር ክርክር ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Duula #ትሰማ (Isheen Haa Dhageessifamtu) jedhamu kan Itoophiyaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru, miidhaa dubartoota fi shamarran irra ga'u ilaalchisee mootummaan tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu gaafata. Duulli kun sirni haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaan rakkoo cimaa akka qaban ibsuun, rakkoo kana furuuf jijjiirama dhaabbataas gaafata. Ta'us, sochii kana irratti namoonni tokko tokko duulli kun dhiibbaa aadaa alaa irraa dhufe jedhanii falmuun, mariin waa'ee aadaa fi mirga dubartootaa bal'inaan akka ka'u taasiseera.

title: Katie Zacharia leaving her White House role less than five days on the job
english: Katie Zacharia has resigned from her position as White House press secretary after less than a week in the role. Her departure follows a widely criticized initial press briefing where she struggled to answer questions and mistakenly identified her husband as the president. President Trump suggested she reconsider the position due to the harsh media scrutiny she faced, while opposition Democrats viewed the event as further evidence of internal instability within the administration.
amharic: ኬቲ ዘካሪያ በዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ፀሐፊነት ከተሾሙ ከአምስት ቀናት ባነሰ ጊዜ ውስጥ ስራቸውን ለቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሰጡት ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ ላይ በተፈጠረው ግራ መጋባት እና በሙያ ብቃታቸው ላይ በተነሱ ጥያቄዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ትችት ከገጠማቸው በኋላ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከሚዲያ እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ጫና ምክንያት ስራውን እንዲያጤኑት መክረዋቸው የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ተቃዋሚ ዲሞክራቶች ይህንን ክስተት የመንግስት አስተዳደር ድክመት ማሳያ አድርገው አቅርበውታል።
oromo: Keetii Zaakaariyaa guyyoota shaniifillee hin guunneef itti gaafatamummaa barreessituu oduu mana mootummaa (White House) erga fudhatanii booda hojii gadhiisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufeyyuu ibsa oduu jalqabaa irratti rakkoo quunnamee fi gaaffii waa'ee qulqullina barnootaafi muuxannoo isaanirratti kaasame hordofee dha. Pirezidaanti Traamp miidiyaadhaan dhiibbaa cimaa irra gahaa waan tureef hojicha akka deebisanii yaadan gorsanii kan turan yoo ta'u, mormitoonni Paartii Dimokiraataas haalli kun cimina dhabuu bulchiinsa mootummaa kan argisiisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
english: Italy's Defence Minister, Guido Crosetto, has criticized the US administration for potentially limiting intelligence and satellite support for Ukraine, arguing such actions would only empower Russia. He stated that displaying weakness to Vladimir Putin will encourage him to prolong the conflict rather than negotiate for peace. This marks a growing tension in the relationship between Italy and the Trump administration regarding their opposing approaches to the war.
amharic: የጣሊያን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ጊዶ ክሮሴቶ አሜሪካ ለዩክሬን የምትሰጠውን የሳተላይት እና የስለላ ድጋፍ መገደቧ ትልቅ ስህተት እንደሆነ ገለጹ። እንዲህ አይነት ድርጊቶች የሩሲያውን ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲንን የበለጠ እንደሚያበረታቱና ጦርነቱን እንደሚያረዝሙት አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ላይ በጣሊያን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የፖሊሲ ልዩነት በግልጽ እያሳየ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Xaaliyaanii Guido Crosetto, Ameerikaan gargaarsa satalaayitii fi odeeffannoo isheen Yukreeniif gootu hir'isuun dogoggora guddaa akka ta'e dubbatan. Gochi kun Prezidaantii Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin jajjabeessuun waraana akka dheeressuuf malee, nagaa buusuuf akka hin gargaarre akeekkachiisan. Ilaalchi kun dhimma waraana Yukreen irratti walhubannoo dhabuu Xaaliyaanii fi mootummaa Ameerikaa gidduu jiru ifa godha.

title: Oregon school shooter was former special needs student, police say
english: A 16-year-old former special-needs student armed with a shotgun killed three children and a teacher at an elementary school in Oregon. The attacker was confronted by a brave teacher and ultimately fatally shot by a parent who arrived on the scene. Authorities are currently investigating how the teenager gained access to the weapon used in this tragic event.
amharic: በኦሪገን ግዛት አንዲት አንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ የ16 ዓመት ወጣት የቀድሞ የልዩ ፍላጎት ተማሪ ሽጉጥ በመጠቀም ሶስት ህጻናትን እና አንድ አስተማሪ ገድሏል። ወንጀለኛው በአንድ ደፋር አስተማሪ ታግሎ ከቆየ በኋላ በስፍራው የደረሰ አንድ ወላጅ ተኩሶ ገድሎታል። ባለሥልጣናት ታዳጊው ይህንን የጦር መሳሪያ እንዴት ሊያገኝ እንደቻለ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ooriganitti mana barumsaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa tokko keessatti dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 16 fi barataa haala addaa (special needs) ture tokko qawwee hidhatee barattoota sadii fi barsiisaa tokko ajjeeseera. Dargaggeessi kun barsiistuu tokkoon erga qabamee booda, abbaan tokko iddoo sana ga’ee isa ajjeeseera. Aangeyyoonni dargaggeessi kun qawwee kana akkamitti akka argate qorachaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump claims US Navy blockade stops Iranian ships in Hormuz
english: President Donald Trump has stated that the US Navy has successfully implemented a blockade preventing Iranian vessels from entering the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, the British government has issued a travel warning for Saudi Arabia, urging citizens to avoid non-essential trips due to recent strikes by Houthi rebels. These developments highlight increasing regional tensions and safety concerns in the Middle East.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል የኢራን መርከቦች ወደ ሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ እንዳይገቡ የሚያግድ ውጤታማ እገዳ መጣሉን አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ የብሪታንያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ ዜጎቹ ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚያደርጉትን አስፈላጊ ያልሆነ ጉዞ እንዲያስወግዱ አስጠንቅቋል። እነዚህ ክንውኖች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doonaaldi Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, humnoonni galaana Ameerikaa markeewwan Iraan daandii Hormuz akka hin qaxxaamurre dhorkataniiru. Gamtaan biyyoota Ingiliiziis, weerara finxaaleyyiin Huutii Yaman raawwatanin walqabatee, lammiileen isaanii gara Sa'udii Arabiyaatti imala barbaachisaa hin taane akka hin goone gorsaniiru. Taateewwan kun naannawa Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti yaaddoon nageenyaa dabalaa akka jiru agarsiisu.

title: Trump mocks Middle Eastern names with ‘Mohammed’ joke
english: During a political rally in Georgia, former US President Donald Trump made a controversial joke regarding Middle Eastern names. While discussing the potential future leadership of Iran, he suggested that anyone unsure of a person's name from that region should simply call them 'Mohammed.' This remark has drawn attention for its mocking tone toward Middle Eastern culture.
amharic: ቀድሞ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ፕሬዝዳንት የነበሩት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በጆርጂያ በተካሄደ የፖለቲካ ስብሰባ ላይ ከመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የመጡ ስሞችን አስመልክቶ አወዛጋቢ ቀልድ ተናግረዋል። ስለ ኢራን የወደፊት መሪዎች በሚወያዩበት ወቅት፣ ከመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የመጡ ሰዎችን ስም ማወቅ ከተቸገሩ በቀላሉ 'መሐመድ' ብለው መጥራት እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል። ይህ ንግግራቸው በክልሉ ባህል ላይ ያሾፈ በመሆኑ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, qophii siyaasaa kutaa Joorjiyaa irratti magaalotaa fi maqoota biyyoota Baha Giddu-galeessaa irratti qoosannoo mormii kaasise dubbataniiru. Hoggantoota gara fuulduraa kan Iraan irratti yaada kennuun, namni tokko maqaa nama biyya sanahii yoo wallaale 'Mohammad' jedhee waamuun gahaadha jedhaniiru. Jechi kun aadaa fi maqoota Baha Giddu-galeessaa irratti qoosuu isaa hordofee qaama baay'ee biratti komatameera.

title: Albanian PM blames ‘foreign hands’ for unrest as student protests intensify
english: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama has accused outside forces of inciting violent student protests that have rocked the capital, Tirana, for four consecutive days. Demonstrators are calling for the Prime Minister's resignation due to frustrations over government corruption and inadequate university standards. While the Prime Minister has refused to step down, he indicated a willingness to negotiate on issues related to education costs.
amharic: የአልባኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ለቀናት በተቀሰቀሰው የተማሪዎች ተቃውሞ ውስጥ የውጭ እጆች አሉበት ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በመንግስት ሙስና እና በዩኒቨርሲቲዎች መጥፎ የትምህርት አሰጣጥ የተነሳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ከስልጣን ለመውረድ ፈቃደኛ ባይሆኑም፣ በትምህርት ወጪዎች ዙሪያ ለመነጋገር ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Albaniyaa Edi Rama, magaalaa Tirana keessatti guyyoota afuriif walitti aansuun hiriira mormii barattootaa gaggeeffamaa jiru keessa harki alaa jiraachuu dubbatan. Hiriirtonni kun malaammaltummaa mootummaa fi haala barnootaa gadi bu'aa ta'e mormuun akka isaan aangoo gadi lakkisan gaafachaa jiru. Mummichi Ministiraa aangoo gadhiisuuf kan didan ta'us, baasii barnootaa ilaalchisee mari'achuuf fedhii akka qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
english: A 16-year-old former student launched a deadly shotgun attack at an Oregon elementary school, killing four people before being confronted. A teacher bravely wrestled the gunman to the ground, which allowed a passing father who was armed to intervene and shoot the attacker dead. Local authorities praised these courageous actions, noting that they likely prevented further casualties during the tragic event.
amharic: የ16 ዓመት የቀድሞ ተማሪ በአንድ ኦሪገን የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በጠመንጃ ጥቃት አራት ሰዎችን ገደለ። ጥቃቱ እየተፈጸመ ባለበት ወቅት አንድ መምህር ጠመንጃውን ለመንጠቅ ከጠቋሚው ጋር በመታገል ጊዜ የገዙ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ይያል የነበረ አንድ አባትም ወደ ትምህርት ቤቱ በመግባት ተኳሹን በመተኮስ ገድሎታል። የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት የእነዚህን ግለሰቦች ድፍረት ያደነቁ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊታቸው ተጨማሪ የሰው ህይወት ከመጥፋት እንደታደገ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Barataan waggaa 16 ture tokko mana barnoota sadarkaa tokkooffaa kan Oregonitti namoota afur erraan ga'ee booda, haleellaa isaa itti fufeera. Barsiistuun tokko gootummaan hidhataa kana waliin qabsoo gochuun isaa, abbaan tokko kan hidhannoo qabatee darbuu ture gara mana barnootichaa seenuun haleellaa kana dhaabsisee jira. Poolisiin namoota kunneen gootummaa agarsiisan kana galateeffateera; tarkaanfiin isaanii lubbuu namoota hedduu oolchuuf gargaareera jedhameera.

title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
english: Christina Block, a wealthy German steakhouse heiress, is on trial for allegedly orchestrating the violent kidnapping of her two children from their father in Denmark. Prosecutors claim she hired an Israeli security firm to snatch the children during a fireworks display and transport them to her home in Germany. The investigation into this case unexpectedly uncovered broader ties to intelligence operatives, leading to the separate arrest of a former German spy chief on espionage charges.
amharic: የጀርመን ምግብ ቤት ባለቤት የሆነችው ክርስቲና ብሎክ፣ ልጆቿን በዴንማርክ ከሚኖሩበት አባታቸው ዘንድ በኃይል እንዲታፈኑ በማዘዝ ተከሳለች። አቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት፣ ተጠርጣሪዋ ልጆቹን ለማስጠለፍ የእስራኤል የደህንነት ተቋምን በመቅጠር ወደ ጀርመን ቤትዋ እንዲወሰዱ አድርጋለች። በዚህ ክስ ውስጥ የተሳተፉ ግለሰቦችን በሚመረምርበት ወቅት፣ የቀድሞ የጀርመን የደህንነት መሥሪያ ቤት ኃላፊ በሰላይነት እና በመክዳት ወንጀል እንዲታሰሩ ምክንያት የሆነ ሌላ ጉዳይ መገኘቱ ጉዳዩን ይበልጥ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Christina Block kan jedhamtu fi qabeenya guddaa kan qabdu dhaabbata nyaataa Jarmanii, ijoollee ishii lama abbaasaanii kan ta’e irraa biyya Deenmaark keessatti akka humnaan butaman gochuun himatamtee jirti. Himattonni akka jedhanitti, ijoollee kana butuuf dhaabbata nageenyaa Israa’el kan qacartee fi humnaan buttee gara mana ishii Jarmanitti geessiseetti. Qorannoo dhimma kanaa irratti namoota hirmaatan sakatta’uun, ajajaan duraanii tajaajila iccitii Jarmanii yakka basaastummaatiin akka qabamuuf sababa ta’eera.

title: Leeds vs Manchester United: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
english: Leeds United is set to host Manchester United at Elland Road this Sunday in a highly anticipated Premier League match. While Leeds has shown strong form recently with a solid start to their season, Manchester United is currently struggling and facing significant performance challenges. This historic rivalry remains intense as both teams prepare to face off in this important weekend fixture.
amharic: ሊድስ ዩናይትድ በዚህ እሁድ በእንግሊዝ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድን በሜዳው ያስተናግዳል። ሊድስ ዩናይትድ በውድድር ዘመኑ ጥሩ አቋም እያሳየ ቢሆንም፣ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ግን በአስቸጋሪ ወቅት ውስጥ በመሆኑ በብዙ ችግሮች ውስጥ እያለፈ ይገኛል። ሁለቱ ቡድኖች ረጅም ጊዜ ያስቆጠረ ታሪካዊ ፉክክር ስላላቸው ጨዋታው በብዙዎች ዘንድ በጉጉት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Dilbata dhufu kana tapha Premier League Ingilizii irratti, gareen Leeds United mana isaanii Elland Road irratti Manchester United keessummeessuuf qophaa'eera. Leeds yeroo ammaa qormaata cimaa keessa kan jiru yoo ta'u, Manchester United ammoo sadarkaa gad aanaa fi rakkoo tapha cimaa keessa jira. Taphi kun wal dorgommii seenaa qabeessa garee lamaan gidduu jiru waan ta'eef, namoonni hedduu ni eeggatu.

title: Italy probes Israel’s Katz over abuse, sexual assault of flotilla activists
english: Italian prosecutors have launched an investigation into Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz and 12 other high-ranking officials regarding the mistreatment of activists. The probe follows allegations from 50 Italian citizens who claim they were subjected to torture, kidnapping, and sexual assault during the interception of Gaza-bound humanitarian flotillas in 2025 and 2026. The activists reported experiencing physical abuse, threats, and multiple instances of rape while in Israeli custody.
amharic: የጣሊያን አቃቤ ህግ የእስራኤሉን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝን ጨምሮ በ12 ከፍተኛ የደህንነት እና የወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ምርመራው የተጀመረው ወደ ጋዛ ሰብዓዊ እርዳታ ለማድረስ ሲጓዙ በነበሩ የፍሎቲላ አክቲቪስቶች ላይ የደረሰው እስራት፣ ስቃይ እና ወሲባዊ ጥቃት በተመለከተ በ50 የጣሊያን ዜጎች የቀረበውን ክስ ተከትሎ ነው። ተጎጂዎቹ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዙበት ወቅት ድብደባ፣ የሞት ዛቻ እና አስገድዶ መድፈር እንደተፈጸመባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Xaaliyaan ministira ittisa biyyaa Israa’el Isiraa’el Kaatz fi qondaaltota waraanaa fi nageenyaa olaanoo 12 irratti qorannoo jalqabuu isaa beeksisera. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame lammiilee Xaaliyaan 50 ta’an, bara 2025 fi 2026 gargaarsa namoomaa gara Gaazaa geessuuf osoo jiranii harka Israa’elitti yeroo qabaman miidhaa qaamaa, butii fi qabsoo saalqunnamtii irratti raawwatame jechuun himannoo dhiyeessan irratti hundaa’uun dha. Miidhamtoonni kun yeroo hidhamanii turanitti reebicha, sodaachisa du’aa fi dirqisiisuun saalqunnamtii raawwatamee akka ture himaniiru.

title: Families demand justice after Pakistan school collapse
english: Families in Pakistan are calling for accountability following a tragic school building collapse. The victims' relatives are demanding justice as they mourn those lost in the incident. Authorities are under pressure to investigate the cause of the structural failure and ensure such disasters are prevented in the future.
amharic: በፓኪስታን የትምህርት ቤት ህንጻ መፍረስን ተከትሎ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ፍትህን እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። የሟች ቤተሰቦች በደረሰው አሳዛኝ አደጋ የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ሀዘን በመግለጽ ለጉዳዩ አፋጣኝ ምላሽ እንዲሰጥ ይፈልጋሉ። ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ እንዲያጣሩ እና መሰል አደጋዎች እንዳይደገሙ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ግፊት እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Paakistaan keessatti mana barumsaa tokko kufuun walqabatee, maatiin miidhaan irra ga'e haqa barbaadaa jiru. Maatiin namoota lubbuun isaanii darbe balaa mudateen gadda guddaa keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, himata hatattamaa gaafataa jiru. Aangeyyoonni sababa balaa kanaa qoratanii gara fuulduraatti balaa akkanaa akka hin mudanne tarkaanfii akka fudhatan gaafachaa jiru.

title: Yemen’s government says Houthis fired two missiles at Aden airport
english: Yemeni government officials reported that Houthi rebels fired two missiles near the Aden International Airport, narrowly missing a passenger plane. This strike occurred shortly after an attack on the presidential palace and amid escalating violence throughout the country. Meanwhile, government forces claimed to have made significant military progress in Marib and Taiz, reportedly inflicting heavy casualties on Houthi fighters.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት የሁቲ አማጽያን በአደን ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ ሁለት ሚሳኤሎችን መተኮሳቸውን አስታውቋል፤ ጥቃቱም ተሳፋሪዎችን የያዘ አውሮፕላን ሊመታ የነበረ ቢሆንም ጉዳት አልደረሰም። ይህ ጥቃት በፕሬዝዳንታዊው ቤተመንግስት ላይ ከተፈጸመ ጥቃት በኋላ የተከሰተ ሲሆን በሀገሪቱ ያለው ግጭት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። በሌላ በኩል የመንግሥት ኃይሎች በማሪብ እና በታኢዝ ግዛቶች ወሳኝ ድሎችን ማስመዝገባቸውን እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ከባድ ጉዳት ማድረሳቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, gareen Houthii buufata xiyyaaraa Adenitti meeshaa waraanaa gosa mizaayilii lama gadi lakkiseera; xiyyaara imaltoota fe'e irraa fageenya dhihoo ta'een kufuun isaas balaa hamaa irraa oolcheera. Hojiiwwan waraanaa kun kan raawwataman gamoo mootummaa irratti erga haleellaan raawwatamee booda yoo ta'u, waldhibdeen biyyattii keessatti babal'achaa jiraachuu argisiisa. Gama biraatiin, waraanni mootummaa Maribii fi Ta'iz keessatti injifannoo argachuu fi garee Houthii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Meta employees say Lula’s accounts restricted in Brazil election: Report
english: Internal messages from Meta staff suggest that Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's Instagram reach was limited during the election period, while his opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro, received preferential promotion. A Brazilian court has since ordered Meta to ensure fair treatment for both candidates, threatening significant daily fines for non-compliance. While Meta claims the glitches were merely technical and not politically motivated, the company is now legally required to maintain neutral algorithms for the upcoming runoff.
amharic: የሜታ ሰራተኞች በውስጥ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ ወቅት የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ኢንስታግራም ገጾች በምርጫ ወቅት ተገድበው እንደነበር አምነዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ የተቃዋሚው እጩ የፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ገጾች ግን በስርዓቱ እንዲበረታቱ ተደርገዋል። የብራዚል ፍርድ ቤት ሜታ ለሁለቱም እጩዎች እኩል አያያዝ እንዲያደርግ ትእዛዝ የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ ይህንን ካልፈፀመ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቀው አስጠንቅቋል። ኩባንያው ችግሮቹ ቴክኒካዊ እንጂ የፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነት አለመሆናቸውን ቢገልጽም፣ በገለልተኛነት እንዲንቀሳቀስ በህግ ተገዷል።
oromo: Hojjetoonni Meta akka ibsanitti, guyyoota filannoo biyyattii keessatti akkaawuntin Instagram kan pirezidaantii Biraazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva dhiibbaa irra ture, faallaa kanaatiin garuu kan morkataa isaa Flavio Bolsonaro ni guddifamu turan. Manni murtii Biraazil akkaataa kanaan Meta kandideetota lamaanuu qixxee akka ilaalu ajajeera, akkasumas ajaja kana yoo cabse adabbii maallaqaa cimaan akka isa eeggatu hubachiiseera. Meta rakkoon kun dogoggora teeknikaa malee karoora siyaasaa akka hin taane ibsuuf yaaluus, manneen murtii garuu haqa qabeessa ta'uuf akka qaban dirqamsiisaniiru.

title: Saudi Civil Defence issues alerts for Abha and Khamis Mushait
english: Saudi authorities have issued emergency safety warnings for residents in Abha and Khamis Mushait due to potential threats. The government is urging citizens to comply with official safety guidelines. Additionally, officials have strictly prohibited the filming or sharing of information regarding military defense activities and impact sites to avoid legal consequences.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ ባለስልጣናት በአምሃ እና በካሚስ ሙሻይት ለሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ሊከሰት ስለሚችል አደጋ የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። መንግስት ነዋሪዎች ይፋዊ የደህንነት መመሪያዎችን እንዲከተሉ አሳስቧል። በተጨማሪም ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ የመከላከያ ስራዎችን ወይም የጥቃት ቦታዎችን በምስል መቅረጽ ወይም ማሰራጨት ህጋዊ ተጠያቂነት እንደሚያስከትል በግልጽ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii magaalaa Abha fi Khamis Mushait keessa kan jiraatan lammiilee isaaniif, balaa mudachuu danda'uuf jecha akeekkachiisa nageenyaa dabarseera. Mootummaan lammiileen qajeelfama nageenyaa sirriitti akka hordofan gaafateera. Kana malees, hojii ittisa waraanaa fi iddoowwan miidhaan irra ga'e viidiyoon wokuu ykn odeeffannoo isaa tamsaasuun seeraan nama gaafachiisuu akka danda'u hubachiiseera.

title: Saudi-led coalition says it will target Houthi arms smuggling operations
english: The Saudi-led coalition has announced plans to launch military operations against Houthi forces accused of smuggling weapons into Yemen's Hodeidah province by sea. A spokesperson confirmed the initiative via social media, although specific details regarding the timing or methods remain undisclosed. This move aims to disrupt illegal arms transfers entering the region through maritime routes.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በየመን ሆዴዳ ግዛት በኩል በባህር መንገድ መሳሪያ ሲያዘዋውሩ የነበሩ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን ኢላማ እንደሚያደርግ አስታውቋል። የጥምረቱ ቃል አቀባይ ይህንን እርምጃ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በኩል ያረጋገጡ ቢሆንም፣ ስለተግባራዊነቱ ተጨማሪ ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ህገ-ወጥ የጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውርን ለመግታት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mootummoonni gamtaa Sa'udii dursuun Yemen keessatti hidhattoota Hutiif meeshaa waraanaa galaana irraa seensisaa jiranirratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf akka karoorfatan ibsaniiru. Dubbi himaan gamtichaa odeeffannoo kana miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti kan mirkaneessan yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti garuu malawwan tarkaanfichaa irratti ibsa bal'aa hin kennine. Tarkaanfiin kun qaqqabiinsa meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa gara naannichaa seenan dhaabuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Over 340 Palestinian children killed in Gaza since ceasefire: Unicef
english: UNICEF reports that over 340 children have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire, with many more suffering injuries and losing their parents. Hundreds of thousands of children remain displaced in poor conditions, facing a harsh winter with no access to basic services like clean water or sanitation. The agency is urging for the entry of essential equipment and fuel to prevent a public health disaster and protect vulnerable youths.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የህጻናት መርጃ ድርጅት (ዩኒሴፍ) እንደገለጸው፣ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ከተደረገ በኋላ ከ340 በላይ ህጻናት በጋዛ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በተጨማሪም በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት መኖሪያቸውን ለቀው በችግር ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ የንፁህ ውሃ እና የጤና አገልግሎት እጦት ለከባድ የክረምት ወቅት ተጋልጠዋል። ድርጅቱ የህጻናትን ህይወት ለመታደግ የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች እና ነዳጅ ወደ ጋዛ እንዲገቡ አጥብቆ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: dhaabbanni UNICEF akka gabaasetti, guyyaa waldhabdee dhaabuun labsame kaasee ijoolleen 340 ol ta'an Gaza keessatti lubbuun darbeera. Ijoolleen kuma dhibbaan lakka'aman manaa buqqa'anii haala rakkisaa keessa jiraachaa jiru, akkasumas tajaajila bu'uuraa kan akka bishaan qulqulluu fi qulqullina fayyaa dhabuun ganna hammaataa mudachaa jiru. Dhaabbatichi lubbuu ijoollee oolchuuf, meeshaalee barbaachisoo fi boba'aan gara Gaza akka galu mootummoota gaafachaa jira.

title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
english: President Donald Trump has rejected claims that he ordered restrictions on the Starshield internet network used by Ukraine, which had limited drone operations. While Elon Musk pointed to the Pentagon as the potential source of these service speed limits, reports suggest the decision may have originated within the White House. This incident follows rising tensions between the US and Ukraine over Kyiv's decision to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዩክሬን የምትጠቀምበት የስታርሺልድ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት ላይ ገደብ እንዲጣል ማዘዛቸውን አስተባበሉ። ኤሎን መስክ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነቱ መቀነስ ከፔንታጎን የመጣ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢጠቁሙም፣ ዘገባዎች ግን ውሳኔው ከዋይት ሀውስ የመነጨ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይጠቁማሉ። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው ኪየቭ በሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን እንደገና በመጀመሯ በአሜሪካ እና በዩክሬን መካከል አለመግባባት በተፈጠረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp tajaajila interneetii 'Starshield' kan Yuukireen itti fayyadamtu irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf ajaja kennuu isaanii haalan. Elon Mask rakkoon saffisa interneetii kun Pentagooniin kan dhufe ta'uu akka danda'u ibsus, gabaasoonni garuu murtoon kun mana mootummaa (White House) keessaa akka dhufe ni agarsiisu. Walitti buutiin kun kan uumame yeroo Yuukireen lafa suphaa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa geggeessuu ishee itti fufuun harka wal-qabatanii hojjechuun wal-dhabdee ishee fi Ameerikaa gidduutti uumamee ture.

title: Students in Europe are rising up to call for better education
english: Students across various European nations are participating in protests to advocate for significant improvements to their national education systems. In Albania, the government has responded to the unrest by claiming that outside actors are influencing the demonstrators. These protests highlight growing student frustration with current academic conditions and policies throughout the region.
amharic: በተለያዩ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ስርዓታቸው እንዲሻሻል በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ። በአልባኒያ መንግስት የተማሪዎቹን ተቃውሞ ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጋር በማያያዝ ክስ ሰንዝሯል። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች በአውሮፓ ያሉ ተማሪዎች አሁን ባለው የትምህርት ጥራትና ሁኔታ ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Barattoonni biyyoota Awurooppaa garaagaraa keessa jiran sirni barnootaa isaanii akka fooyya'u gaafachuun hiriira mormii geggeessaa jiru. Hiriirri kun barattoonni haala barnootaa amma jiru irratti gaddaa fi komii cimaa akka qaban kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Food affordability fears plague Gaza as Israel halts commercial goods
english: Gaza is facing a worsening humanitarian crisis as the entry of essential commercial goods like food and winter clothing has been blocked for two days. This stoppage stems from a tax disagreement between local business owners and the governing authorities in the territory. Residents are now deeply concerned that these supply disruptions will cause prices to surge amid an already severe economic collapse and widespread hunger.

oromo: Gaazaatti gabaan oomishaalee barbaachisoo akka kuduraa, muduraa, foonii fi uffata gannaa guyyoota lamaaf waan dhaabateef rakkoon namoomaa hammaachaa jira. Kun kan ta'e daldaltoota naannichaa fi bulchiinsa Hamaas gidduutti wal dhabdee gibiraa uumame irraa kan ka'edha. Dhabamuun oomishaalee kanaa rakkoo beelaa fi dinagdee gadi fagoo naannichaa keessa jiru irra dabalatee, gatiin meeshaalee akka ol ka'u yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Oregon community mourns victims of school shooting
english: A community in Bend, Oregon, is grieving after a tragic shooting at an elementary school left three children and one teacher dead. A 16-year-old attacker forced his way into the building by shooting through locked doors. The incident ended when another individual, who had pursued the teenager into the school, killed him.
amharic: በቤንድ፣ ኦሪገን የሚገኝ ማህበረሰብ በአንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ አሳዛኝ የተኩስ አደጋ ሶስት ህጻናት እና አንድ መምህር ህይወታቸው በማለፉ ጥልቅ ሀዘን ላይ ይገኛል። የ16 ዓመት ወጣት በቁልፍ የተቆለፈውን የትምህርት ቤቱን በር በጥይት በመክፈት ወደ ውስጥ ገብቷል። ወጣቱን ተከትሎ ወደ ውስጥ የገባ ሌላ ሰው ተኩሶ በመግደሉ ጥቃቱ ሊቆም ችሏል።
oromo: Godina Bend, Oregon keessatti manneen barnoota sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti balaa dhukaasaa mudateen ijoolleen sadii fi barsiisaan tokko lubbuun isaanii darbuun isaa hawaasicha gadda keessa galcheera. dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 16 ta'e tokko balbala cufamee ture rasaasaan cabsee mana barnootichaa keessa seenuun miidhaa kana geessiseera. Dargaggeessicha duukaa bu'ee mana barnootichaa keessa kan seene namni tokko isa ajjeesuun balaan sun dhaabateera.

title: AOC transfers $1m to Michigan candidate El-Sayed in progressive push
english: Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has donated $1 million to support Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed's campaign. She stated that this significant financial backing is intended to counter the discriminatory attacks and smears directed at El-Sayed due to his background and political views. This move highlights a major effort by progressive leaders to bolster El-Sayed’s lead against his Republican opponent ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አባል አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ በሚቺጋን የሴኔት እጩ ለሆኑት አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ የምረቃ ዘመቻ አንድ ሚሊዮን ዶላር ድጋፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የተደረገው በኤል-ሳዬድ ማንነት እና የፖለቲካ አመለካከት ላይ ያነጣጠረውን አሉታዊ ዘመቻ ለመከላከል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት መጪውን የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ አስመልክቶ የሪፐብሊካን ተፎካካሪያቸውን እየመሩ የሚገኙትን ኤል-ሳዬድን ለማጠናከር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Miseensi Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Amerikaa Aleksandriyaa Okasiyo-Korteziin, dorgomaa Senaatii Miishigan kan ta'an Abduls El-Saayediif deeggarsa maallaqaa miliyoona tokko kennaniiru. Gumaachi kun kan taasifameef, sababa eenyummaa fi ilaalcha siyaasaa El-Saayedirratti duula suukanneessaa gaggeeffamaa jiru ittisuuf akka ta'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun dorgomaa Paartii Ripaabilikaanii kanneen dursaa jiran El-Saayediin filannoo dhufuuf qophii guddaa taasisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Trump told new press secretary to ‘reconsider’ role
english: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia is stepping down after serving in the position for less than a week. President Donald Trump advised her to rethink her appointment due to the intense pressure and criticism she faced from the public and the media. Her departure marks a very short tenure in this high-profile role.

Pirezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp dhiibbaa fi qeeqa cimaa miidiyaalee fi uummata irraa isaan mudateen walqabatee, aangoo kana irratti irra deebiin akka yaadan isaan gorsanii turan. Gadii ba'uun isaanii kun bakka hojii olaanaa kana irratti yeroo gabaabaa qofa akka turan mul'isa.

title: US weighs lifting sanctions on Iran's 'shadow fleet' to address surging costs
english: The U.S. government is exploring the possibility of easing sanctions on a network of oil tankers known as the 'shadow fleet' that are currently linked to Iran and Russia. Officials hope this move will lower record-high shipping costs and stabilize fuel prices ahead of the upcoming elections. By allowing these vessels to operate freely or carry non-sanctioned goods, the administration aims to improve the global flow of energy resources.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በአሁኑ ወቅት ከኢራን እና ከሩሲያ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን 'ጥላ መርከቦች' ላይ የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ለማቃለል እያጤነ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምርጫ ወቅት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ እና የትራንስፖርት ወጪ ለመቀነስ ነው። እነዚህ መርከቦች ያለምንም ገደብ እንዲሰሩ ወይም ህጋዊ የነዳጅ ምርቶችን እንዲያጓጉዙ በመፍቀድ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦትን ለማረጋጋት ታቅዷል።

Tarkaanfiin kun kanneen uumame kanneen gatiin boba'aa fi geejjibaa yeroo filannoo gahuu isaa wajjin walqabatee fooyyessuufi. Markaboonni kun akka bilisaan socho'anii fi meeshaalee heyyama qaban akka fe'an hayyamuun, dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa akka tasgabaa'u abdii godhatameera.

title: Hormuz controlled by US and allies, not Iran: Centcom chief
english: The head of US Central Command stated that the US and its allies, rather than Iran, hold control over the Strait of Hormuz. By blocking Iranian ports, the US has severely hampered Iran's oil exports and reduced its influence in the region. Meanwhile, American forces continue to facilitate the secure passage of over a billion barrels of oil for regional partners through this vital waterway.
